release_state: exact public 2.1.1 champion; unchanged local candidate not published

prior_invalid_episode.reason: answer-leaking prompts and ambiguous scoring fields made the first comparison invalid

observed_failures.evidence: Green Movement dogfooding showed that iterative product corrections could inherit feedback, proposal, Gate, promotion, archive, and document-sync work even when the useful checks were product reproduction and focused validation.
The user required task-specific choices before optional skills such as frontend-design or Ponytail are used, with game mechanics distinguished from game UI and HUD work.
A locally repacked 2.1.1 archive differed from the exact public archive while Release Gate still reported local_candidate_ready=true from the older version-only evidence.

pathology.where: task routing, optional-capability activation, and release evidence attribution
pathology.why: Multi-session duration and installed availability acted as implicit authority signals, while release evidence was bound to a version string rather than the exact candidate bytes.

prediction: Without the prompt stating the desired route, the candidate routes multi-session tuning through a concise product checkpoint, presents one task-level choice before an unselected gameplay or HUD skill, keeps frontend-design available for HUD rather than gameplay logic, and applies an explicitly selected Ponytail skill without asking again.
candidate_gate: Start a provisional local candidate only when every candidate decision passes, no unselected optional skill is actually loaded, the selected Ponytail control is actually loaded, both controls pass, four same-model fast-resume runs remain exact and bounded, and comparable paired input cost stays within 20 percent.
falsification_condition: Reject when any ordinary tuning case creates evolution state or an agent version, any unselected optional skill is loaded, choices are repeated instead of consolidated, frontend-design is offered for gameplay logic, an explicitly selected Ponytail skill is not loaded for application, fast-resume read scope changes, or candidate evidence is not bound to exact candidate and evaluator bytes.
claim_boundary: This is fresh DEV and VALIDATION evidence for one unchanged local release candidate after an invalid evaluator was retired. It makes no HOLDOUT, Personal, cross-project, public-release, broad game-quality, or universal context-cost claim.
